```{r load-data}

```

```{r}
#filtering data

hotel_booking_city <- hotel_booking %>%                                                               filter(hotel == "City Hotel")

hotel_booking_resort <- hotel_booking %>%                                                               filter(hotel == "Resort Hotel")

hotel_booking_2 <- select(hotel_booking, 1:7, 15:29)



```


```{r}
#peak seasons

hotel_city_adr <- hotel_booking_city %>%
 filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
   group_by(arrival_date_month, arrival_date_year) %>%                                                                
   summarise(avr_adr_city = mean(adr))
   
hotel_resort_adr <- hotel_booking_resort %>%
 filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
   group_by(arrival_date_month, arrival_date_year) %>%
  
  summarise(avr_adr_resort = mean(adr))
```


```{r}
#Visualization for resort adr

hotel_resort_adr <- hotel_resort_adr %>%
mutate(
    arrival_date_month = factor(
      arrival_date_month,
      levels = c(
        "January", "February", "March", "April",
        "May", "June", "July", "August",
        "September", "October", "November", "December"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

hotel_resort_adr %>%
ggplot( 
    aes(x= arrival_date_month, y= avr_adr_resort,
        col = factor(arrival_date_year),
        group = factor(arrival_date_year))
    )+
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()  +
  labs(
    title = "Average ADR at a Resort Hotel by month",
    subtitle = "Grouped by year",
    x = "Months",
    y = "Average ADR",
    col = "Year"
  )+

  theme_minimal() +
  theme( axis.text.x = 
           element_text(angle = 45, 
                        hjust = 1)
)
```

``` {r}
# Identifying sectors for non-refundable deposits 

# Sorting Resort Hotel bookings 

resort_hb_q3 <- hotel_booking %>%
  filter(hotel == "Resort Hotel") %>%
  mutate(
  lead_time_groups = case_when(
    lead_time <= 14 ~ "Last Minute",
    lead_time <= 90 ~ "Short Term",
    lead_time <= 200 ~ "Medium Term",
    TRUE ~ "Advance Term"
  ),
  risk_group = case_when(
    market_segment == "Online TA" | market_segment == "Offline TA" ~ "External",
    market_segment == "Direct" ~ "Direct",
    market_segment == "Corporate" ~ "Corporate",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  )

resort_risk_table <- resort_hb_q3 %>%
  group_by(risk_group, lead_time_groups) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bookings = n(),
    total_canceled = sum(is_canceled),
    cancellation_rate = (total_canceled / total_bookings) * 100,
    mean_adr = mean(adr)
    
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 

resort_risk_table_sorted <- resort_risk_table %>%
  arrange(desc(cancellation_rate))

```

```{r}

# Sorting city hotel bookings 

city_hb_q3 <- hotel_booking %>%
  filter(hotel == "City Hotel") %>%
  mutate(
  lead_time_groups = case_when(
    lead_time <= 14 ~ "Last Minute",
    lead_time <= 90 ~ "Short Term",
    lead_time <= 200 ~ "Medium Term",
    TRUE ~ "Advance Term"
  ),
  risk_group = case_when(
    market_segment == "Online TA" | market_segment == "Offline TA" ~ "External",
    market_segment == "Direct" ~ "Direct",
    market_segment == "Corporate" ~ "Corporate",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  )

city_risk_table <- city_hb_q3 %>%
  group_by(risk_group, lead_time_groups) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bookings = n(),
    total_canceled = sum(is_canceled),
    cancellation_rate = (total_canceled / total_bookings) * 100,
    mean_adr = mean(adr)
    
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

city_risk_table_sorted <- city_risk_table %>%
  arrange(desc(cancellation_rate))

```

``` {r}
# Visualizing for resort hotel 

resort_risk_table$lead_time_groups <- factor(
  resort_risk_table$lead_time_groups,
                            levels = c("Last Minute", "Short Term", "Medium Term", "Advance Term"))


library(ggplot2)
ggplot(resort_risk_table, aes( x = lead_time_groups, y = risk_group, fill = cancellation_rate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Risk Analysis for Resort Hotel",
    y = "Distribution Channels",
    x = "Booking Time"
  ) +
  theme_gray() 


```

```{r}
# Modelling for Resort Hotel 

library(tidyverse)

library(tidymodels)

resort_model <- resort_hb_q3 %>%
  mutate(
    is_canceled = factor(is_canceled, levels = c("1", "0")),
    risk_group = as.factor(risk_group)
  ) %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, risk_group) %>%
  drop_na()

set.seed(123)
resort_split <- initial_split(resort_model, prop = 0.80)
resort_train <- training(resort_split)
resort_test <- testing(resort_split)

resort_recipe <- recipe(is_canceled ~ lead_time_groups + risk_group, data = resort_train) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

resort_mod <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm")

resort_wflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(resort_recipe) %>%
  add_model(resort_mod)

resort_fit <- resort_wflow %>%
  fit(data = resort_train)

tidy(resort_fit)

resort_preds <- predict(resort_fit, resort_test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(resort_test)


resort_preds %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, risk_group, .pred_1) %>%
  head(10)

resort_preds %>%
  roc_auc(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1)

resort_preds %>%
  roc_curve(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1) %>%
  autoplot()

```
```{r}

library(tidyverse)

library(tidymodels)

city_model <- city_hb_q3 %>%
  mutate(
    is_canceled = factor(is_canceled, levels = c("1", "0")),
    risk_group = as.factor(risk_group)
  ) %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, risk_group) %>%
  drop_na()

set.seed(123)
city_split <- initial_split(city_model, prop = 0.80)
city_train <- training(city_split)
city_test <- testing(city_split)

city_recipe <- recipe(is_canceled ~ lead_time_groups + risk_group, data = resort_train) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

city_mod <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm")

city_wflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(city_recipe) %>%
  add_model(city_mod)

city_fit <- city_wflow %>%
  fit(data = city_train)

tidy(city_fit)

city_preds <- predict(city_fit, city_test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(city_test)

city_preds %>%
  select(is_canceled, lead_time_groups, risk_group, .pred_1) %>%
  head(10)

city_preds %>%
  roc_auc(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1)

city_preds %>%
  roc_curve(truth = is_canceled, .pred_1) %>%
  autoplot()
```


```{r}
#Percentage of cancellations by distribution channel for city hotel 

cancellations_by_channel_city <- hotel_booking_city %>%
  group_by(distribution_channel) %>%
  summarise(
    total_number_bookings_city = n(),
    total_cancelled_city = sum(is_canceled == 1),
    percentage_cancelled_city = mean(is_canceled) * 100
  )
print(cancellations_by_channel_city)
```

```{r}
#Percentage of cancellations by distribution channel for resort hotel

cancellations_by_channel_resort <- hotel_booking_resort %>%
  group_by(distribution_channel) %>%
  summarise(
    total_number_bookings_resort = n(),
    total_cancelled_resort = sum(is_canceled == 1),
    percentage_cancelled_resort = mean(is_canceled) * 100
  )
print(cancellations_by_channel_resort)
```

```{r}
#Graph for cancelled bookings for each distribution channel for city hotel

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(cancellations_by_channel_city,
       aes(x = reorder(distribution_channel, -percentage_cancelled_city),
           y = percentage_cancelled_city,
       fill = distribution_channel)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage_cancelled_city, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Distribution Channel",
    y = "percentage cancelled (%)",
    title = "Percentage of bookings cancelled across each distribution channel for City Hotel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
